entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:1
segments: Now as to the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:2
segments: You yourselves know perfectly that the Day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:3
segments: While men are saying "Peace and safety," then, like birth-pangs upon a woman with child, destruction will come upon them suddenly. In no wise will they escape.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:4
segments: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, that "the Day" should come upon you like a bandit.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:5
segments: For you are all sons of light, and sons of day. We are not of night nor of darkness.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:6
segments: So then let us not be sleeping as do the rest, but let us be watchful and self-controlled.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:7
segments: For those who are sleeping, sleep in the night, and those who are drunken, are drunken in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:8
segments: But let us who are of the day be self-controlled, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:9
segments: For God did not appoint us to wrath, but to win salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:10
segments: He died for us, in order that whether we are keeping vigil [in life] or sleeping [in death] we may ever be living together with him.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:11
segments: So comfort one another, and try to build one another up, as indeed you are doing.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:12
segments: I entreat you, brothers, to acknowledge those who are toiling among you and are your leaders in the Lord, and give you counsel.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:13
segments: Esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. Live in peace among yourselves.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:14
segments: And, brothers, we urge you to admonish the disorderly, comfort the faint-hearted, sustain the weak, lose patience with none.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:15
segments: Take care that none of you ever return evil for evil, but always pursue what is kind to one another and to all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:16
segments: Always be joyful.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:17
segments: Pray without ceasing.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:18
segments: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is the will of God for you in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:19
segments: Quench not the Spirit.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:20
segments: Do not despise prophesyings.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:21
segments: But try all, holding fast to the good.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:22
segments: Hold aloof from every form of evil.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:23
segments: May the God of peace consecrate you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be kept altogether faultless until the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:24
segments: He who calls you is faithful; he will fulfil my prayer.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:25
segments: Brothers, pray for me.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:26
segments: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:27
segments: I adjure you, in the name of the Lord, to have this letter read to all the brothers.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:28
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
